name: SOC-006: Windows Privilege Escalation Detected
description: Detects Windows privilege escalation attempts including UAC bypass binaries (fodhelper, computerdefaults), system token impersonation (PsExec -s, GetSystem), and Potato exploit execution.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%fodhelper.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%computerdefaults.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%psexec%-s%' OR payload ILIKE '%GetSystem%' OR payload ILIKE '%JuicyPotato%' OR payload ILIKE '%PrintSpoof%' OR payload ILIKE '%runas%/user:%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
